embedding.queryFormat: Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query\nQuery: <query>

checks.name: embedding_model
checks.detail: Production embedding provider uses the M4-selected multilingual E5 model.

checks.name: e5_passage_format_and_normalization
checks.detail: Passages are raw and normalized to 1024 dimensions.

checks.name: e5_query_format_and_normalization
checks.detail: Queries use the selected instructed E5 format and normalized vectors.

checks.name: pgvector_cosine_hnsw_query
checks.detail: PostgreSQL retrieval uses pgvector cosine distance with HNSW settings.

checks.name: workspace_filter_before_results
checks.detail: Workspace scope is a SQL filter before rows are ranked or returned.

checks.name: production_context_builder
checks.detail: Production ContextBuilder creates the cited ContextPackage source.

checks.name: single_pass_grounded_ask
checks.detail: A ready ask performs one retrieval and one generation.

checks.name: insufficient_evidence_skips_generation
checks.detail: Insufficient evidence produces no generation call.

checks.name: citation_provenance_mapping
checks.detail: Citation [1] maps only to the included production ContextPackage source.

postgresPgvectorSmoke.reason: Requires an explicitly provisioned PostgreSQL + pgvector database.
postgresPgvectorSmoke.command: RUN_PGVECTOR_SMOKE=1 PGVECTOR_SMOKE_DATABASE_URL=<postgresql+psycopg URL> PYTHONPATH=apps/api python -m pytest apps/api/tests/test_pgvector_smoke.py -q

knownLimitations: This is configuration and infrastructure parity validation, not answer-quality scoring.
The default unit suite uses fake embeddings and generation; it does not download a model or call a provider.
The PostgreSQL smoke test must run against a separately migrated pgvector database.
